upload.name: YanlingMTR 1.0.0 — Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric
upload.changelog: First YanlingMTR public version, based on the checked MTR 3.3.9 maintenance build. New branding and public numbering; preserves mtr save/API identity and addon dependency compatibility. Includes dashboard background/icon fixes and existing networking, train audio, lift and persistence fixes.
